name: channel
description: Your chats in a pane beside Claude Code: read, reply, and get a toast when someone messages you. iMessage today, more chat apps to come.

imessage.title: Read and send your iMessage
imessage.description: true lists your conversations in the pane and can send from it. Needs macOS 13 or later and the terminal, because it reads the local Messages database. false removes the tab and reads nothing.

pictures.title: How picture previews are drawn
pictures.description: auto shows real pixels in kitty and Ghostty and colored blocks elsewhere; a terminal that turns out not to draw pixels falls back to blocks by itself.
options: always real pixels (kitty or Ghostty only)
